name: Stegron the Dinosaur Man — the discard ability's picker leaves out the card discarded as its cost
notes: "Dinosaur Formula — {1}{R}, Discard this card: Until end of turn, target creature you control gets +3/+1 and becomes a Dinosaur in addition to its other types." The ability is used from the hand and the card is discarded as its cost, so it cannot be a target; the picker listed Stegron itself. Same for every "Discard this card:" cost (channel) and "Reveal this card from your hand:" cost (forecast).
